note: When proxy protocol handling is enabled, the request parser inspects the beginning of attacker-controlled input before normal HTTP parsing.

code: switches on the first four bytes of buffer to select PROXY v1 or v2 parsing
note: A payload starting with CRLFCRLF selects the v2 parser path.
The v2 parser interprets the attacker-controlled bytes as a fixed-size PROXY v2 header.
The advertised length is read from the header and added to the fixed signature size.
The parser only accepts headers whose total size is no larger than the local proxy_header_v2 struct.

code: copies source/destination address and port fields from hdr into request->proxy
note: For the TCP4 family, attacker-controlled fields are written into the request proxy state and used later by the server.
After advancing past the header, the parser rescans the remaining buffer for the end of the HTTP headers; malformed size handling here can misalign subsequent parsing.
If parsing continues past the proxy header, the remaining bytes are treated as HTTP request data and may be read from an incorrect position.
